issue.title: just check symvision: ledger_path/read_ledger_records in workspace_claim_ledger.py are unused public symbols
issue.description: just check fails at lint (symvision) with: Unused public functions/classes ... ledger_path in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py, read_ledger_records in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py. Confirmed pre-existing on master (d6f88f7b9), unrelated to any in-flight change: reproduced by stashing all local changes and running 'just _lint-symvision' with only the stale sase-pw.8(project_accent_map) epic-symbol entry removed from the Justfile. Both symbols are exported via __all__ but have zero non-test callers anywhere in src/ (grep confirms only tests/test_running_field_operations.py and tests/logs/test_workspace_claim_ledger.py reference them). read_ledger_records's own docstring says it is 'Intended for the detect phase's sase doctor check and for ad-hoc diagnosis of a reported occupancy conflict' -- that sase doctor wiring does not appear to exist in the current tree, so the fix requires a judgment call (wire it into sase doctor as originally intended, delete it and its test coverage, or add a pragma) rather than a blind rename, which is why I filed this instead of fixing it inline.

task_type_fields.repro: just install && just _lint-symvision on master d6f88f7b9 (after removing the unrelated stale sase-pw.8(project_accent_map) --epic-symbol entry from Justfile:342, itself fixed separately) -> 'Unused public functions/classes ... ledger_path in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py, read_ledger_records in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py'

evidence.note: Independently reproduced on master 7beaf2ac7 in workspace sase_13 with all local changes stashed: just install && just _lint-symvision fails with 'Unused public functions/classes' listing ledger_path in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py and read_ledger_records in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py. No Justfile edit was needed this time — the stale sase-pw.8(project_accent_map) --epic-symbol entry is already gone from master, so these two symbols are the standing failure. Note that the same run now also reports three further unused publics that postdate this bead: OccupantRecord and occupant_marker_path in src/sase/workspace_provider/occupant.py, and WorkspaceOccupiedError in src/sase/core/occupancy_guard.py (from 7a2906e13, in-progress epic sase-q0); those are recorded on sase-q0 and are not part of this bead's scope.

Independently reproduced by the sase-pw land agent on master 00e396be8 (newer than the existing +1's 7beaf2ac7) in workspace sase_15, after 'just install'. 'just check' passed fmt/ruff/mypy/flags/pyscripts/test-waits/changelog/terminology, then failed lint (symvision) on ledger_path and read_ledger_records in src/sase/logs/workspace_claim_ledger.py (alongside the three sase-q0.3 occupancy symbols already noted on sase-q0). The only local change in this tree is a 2-line import fix in src/sase/main/project_handler.py. Corroborates the PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP raised by epic phase sase-pw.9; sase-pw touches none of these files. Because symvision gates before the test lane, this failure also hides every scoped/full test result from 'just check' for every agent on this host.
